description: Na₄FeO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.34 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.50 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.42 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.36 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.82 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.53 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.43 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.41 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and one longer (1.94 Å) Fe-O bond length. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.93 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-64°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-64°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-52°.
